sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: GLiNER-BioMed - GitHub
sources.snippet: GLiNER-BioMed introduces a specialized suite of efficient open biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) models based on the GLiNER framework. GLiNER-BioMed leverages synthetic annotations distilled from large generative biomedical language models to achieve state-of-the-art zero-shot and few-shot performance in biomedical entity recognition tasks.

sources.title: rpeel/glitext-small-biomed · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GLiNER is a Named Entity Recognition (NER) model capable of identifying any entity type using a bidirectional transformer encoders (BERT-like). It provides a practical alternative to traditional NER models, which are limited to predefined entities, and Large Language Models (LLMs) that, despite their flexibility, are costly and large for resource-constrained scenarios.

sources.snippet: Results To address these issues, we introduce GLiNER-BioMed, a domain-adapted suite of GLiNER models for biomedicine. Our approach first distills the annotation capabilities of large language models (LLMs) into a smaller, more efficient model, enabling the generation of high-coverage biomedical NER data.
